title: 第二十五章 神隐森林第二十六章 发现圣灵果
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
皇帝稍作思考后回答道，“近期我会宣布依莲作为皇位继承者。”
作为帝王他优先考虑的是利益，只要获得昆仑这个盟友，其他国家或者势力在想动崇明国也得掂量一下了。
事情圆满结束后，秦天就准备出发前往神隐森林。
明依莲知道这个消息后，就把皇宫最好的马车送给秦天，也免得他们自己赶路。
马车的马是妖王，车子也是非常的舒适大气，所以秦天就收下了。
本来性子就有些懒散的他，能躺着赶路自然是非常乐意的。
只是他们刚出皇宫就被一群人拦了下来。
带头的就是二皇子和一位身穿盔甲的男子。
秦天和安妙菱走了下来，冷冷的看向了二皇子。
二皇子指着秦天说道：“舅舅就是他们打的我，他还说是我大爷爷。”
盔甲男子没有急着动手，而是问道，“阁下是谁？为什么对我国皇子出手。”
“如果不给个说法，我怕是不能让二位离开了。”
还没等秦天说话，安妙菱就拔出了剑。
瞬间剑意弥漫全场。
感受到剑意后盔甲男子也被镇住了。
秦天淡淡的说道，“给点教训就算了。”说完他转身回到马车。
安妙菱挥舞着冰璃剑用力一挑，一刀剑光闪过。
哗！
盔甲男子的一只手臂直接飞了出去。
他捂着手臂露出一脸痛苦的神情，他终于知道眼前的人是谁了。

这么年轻漂亮，又这么强的人，在他的情报中只有一人。
那就是最近名震东洲的安妙菱，号称圣境之下第一人。
也只有这种人。
才能让他这个造化境三重的强者没有还手之力。
一旁的二皇子更是吓傻了，连忙跪在地上求饶。
安妙菱嫌弃的看了二皇子一眼就回到马车上。
随后马车继续前行，前往神隐森林。
马车中，秦天说道，“为师休息一会。”
说完便躺下，并且把头枕在了安妙菱柔软的大腿上。
可能是触感太好了，所以他不停的动弹，在大腿上蹭啊蹭的。
闻着少女的芬芳，他有些迷醉了。
content_en:
The emperor thought for a moment and replied, "I will announce Elaine as the successor to the throne in the near future."
As an emperor, his priority is interests. As long as he has Kunlun as an ally, other countries or forces will have to think twice before trying to move Chongming.
After the matter was successfully concluded, Qin Tian was ready to set off for the Shenyin Forest.
After Ming Yilian knew the news, she gave Qin Tian the best carriage in the palace to save them from traveling on their own.
The horse in the carriage was a demon king, and the carriage was very comfortable and elegant, so Qin Tian accepted it.
He was a bit lazy by nature, so he was naturally very happy to lie down and go on the road.
But as soon as they left the palace, they were stopped by a group of people.
The second prince and a man in armor were leading the way.
Qin Tian and An Miaoling walked down and looked at the second prince coldly.
The second prince pointed at Qin Tian and said, "Uncle, they beat me, and he even said he was my great-uncle."
The man in armor did not rush to take action, but asked, "Who is your Excellency? Why did you attack the prince of our country."
"If you don't give me an explanation, I'm afraid I won't be able to let you two leave."
Before Qin Tian could speak, An Miaoling drew his sword.
In an instant, the sword intent filled the whole place.
After feeling the sword's intent, the armored man was also restrained.
Qin Tian said calmly, "Just teach him a lesson." After saying that, he turned around and returned to the carriage.
An Miaoling wielded the ice glass sword and struck hard, and the sword light flashed past.
Wow!
One of the armored man's arms flew out.
He covered his arms with a painful expression on his face. He finally knew who the person in front of him was.
There was only one person in his information who was so young, beautiful and strong.
That is An Miaoling, who is famous in Dongzhou recently and is known as the number one person under the Holy Realm.
There are only such people.
Only then could he, a strong man at the third level of Creation Realm, be unable to fight back.
The second prince on the side was even more frightened and quickly knelt on the ground and begged for mercy.
An Miaoling glanced at the second prince with disgust and returned to the carriage.
The carriage then continued on its way to the Shenyin Forest.
In the carriage, Qin Tian said, "Take a rest for the teacher."
After saying that, he lay down and rested his head on An Miaoling's soft thighs.
Maybe it felt too good, so he kept moving and rubbing it on his thigh.
Smelling the girl's fragrance, he was a little intoxicated.
